name: Pegasus Bridge
origin_anchor: ww2maps.net site 995 position, 'bridge centre' per the level plan and CATHAL's figure
origin_note: origin rounded to whole metres; local = L93 - origin; local axes are Lambert-93 grid axes (X east, Y grid north)

height_base.note: z_local = NGF-IGN69 height - base. Base = RGE ALTI 1 m height at the origin (bridge point), bilinear, rounded to 0.01 m. Set by terrain.py in S3.

north.note: at lng -0.2746 grid north is about 2.4 deg west of true north (true north is 2.4 deg east of local +Y)

playable_box_l93.note: bounding box of the lat/lng box; the box is slightly rotated in grid terms, so this is the enclosing rectangle

units: metres, Z up, 1 Blender unit = 1 m
